findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "angel-numbers" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_angel_numbers_daily · Private data: get_angel_numbers_lookup · Public sink: post_angel_numbers_daily.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_angel_numbers_daily · Private data: get_angel_numbers_lookup · Public sink: post_angel_numbers_daily

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
